PR #42 is up: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/42

**Summary of what shipped (Phase 5, metadata_knowledge_consolidation):**

- Reconciled MASTER_INDEX.yaml's `registries:` section with `knowledge_engine` via a documented, enforced one-way sync — new `upsert-knowledge-fragment`/`list-knowledge` subcommands in `superboss-register.py`, plus `sync_master_index_registries.py` which gives every one of the 92 registries entries a real, drift-detecting knowledge_engine row, wired into `task-gateway.py close` so it runs automatically.
- Found and fixed a genuine live-vs-repo drift in MASTER_INDEX.yaml itself (the live file was missing the `auditor_engine` entry and phases 2-4 status) — all live-tested end-to-end.
- On the SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN gap: confirmed the token is genuinely invalid (uniform 401 across three Management API endpoints) — not fixable in code, since Supabase PATs are dashboard-only. Filed it as an Owner decision, and fixed the part that *is* a code gap: the cron refresh now emails the Owner on every failed attempt instead of degrading silently (live-tested — real email sent, then correctly rate-limited on retry).
- Closed out phase_5 in the phase plan file with full evidence, satisfying both SUCCESS_CRITERIA checks.

Next phase (phase_6) depends on this one and is now unblocked for the auto-continuation cron to pick up.
